sources.title: From nucleotides to semantics: genomic representation learning via ...
sources.snippet: Here we present GenoJEPA, a genomic representation learning framework based on joint-embedding predictive architecture. GenoJEPA combines continuous patching with semantic alignment, shifting the optimization from local base reconstruction to semantic alignment in latent space.

sources.title: PDF GeneJepa: A Predictive World Model of the Transcriptome - bioRxiv
sources.snippet: Abstract We introduce GeneJepa, a self-supervised foundation model that learns a predictive world model of single-cell transcriptomes. Based on the Joint-Embedding Predictive Architecture, GeneJepa predicts latent representations of masked gene sets from visible context, a shift away from reconstructing noisy expression values and toward world-model style inference over cellular state.
